name: Ahiru no Pantsu
source:
My name is Rika. I live with my mother. Today I sell pantsu in town. Although it is already late, only two pieces have been sold. What shall I do...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-february-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
我叫里香，和母亲一起生活。今天我在城里卖内裤。虽然已经很晚了，却只卖出去两条。我该怎么办……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-february-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
